title: Audio Reflection Markers
user: Podcast and lecture listeners who need to turn a personally useful moment into one short recall/action prompt without trying to summarize an entire episode.
smallest_useful_product: Mobile-first PWA for user-supplied audio/video links or local files: one-button timestamp marker, typed/voice takeaway, optional action date, and Markdown/CSV export.
success_measure: In four weeks, 50% of saved markers receive a follow-up recall/action check, with median capture time under 20 seconds.
constraints: Use only local files or user-entered timestamps/links; do not fetch or redistribute copyrighted audio; microphone permission is optional and local. No downloading, transcription, summaries, or public clip sharing.
